summary: Walker County, TX: survey mark places the lookout tower on site by 1935; Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as Tower Gone.

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey monumented the station; its description places the mark on land occupied by the Farris lookout tower. Mark stamped FARRIS 1935.
Texas Highway Department recovery: original description satisfactory; mark and reference disks 1 and 2 recovered in good condition.

notes_for_editor: Coordinates match: NGS NAD83 30 35 18.12 N, 095 43 35.68 W equals the record's lat/lon. The 1935 description places the tower at the mark, so the tower was standing by 1935; build date and design are unknown. Gone rests on the FFLA list alone; no removal date or photo was found. The qualifier 'West Sandy' is not explained in any source read; the NGS station is simply FARRIS. NGS lists the mark's NAVD 88 height as 120.65 m (395.8 ft); this is the mark's ground height, not the tower's, so elevation_m was not changed. Not reached: Google Books preview of Cavallerano, Fire in the Piney Woods (Texas A&M University Press, 2025), which covers Texas towers and may name this one; the in-book search returned HTTP 429. Duke University Press abstract returned 403. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the story no longer ties this tower to the Forest Service program. The Texas column (which does not name Farris) is cited only for that background.
